Description: Core vector and relational data layer for city knowledge base and trip management
Implement city_knowledge_vectors with metadata filters (city_id, entity_type, seasonality, vibes, price_tier). Search latency < 100ms. Batch ingestion 100+ entities/min.
Create cities, entities, vectors, trips, feedback tables with FK constraints and proper indexing. Migration scripts included.
Automated city ingestion pipeline with normalization and QA
End-to-end pipeline: OSM + Wikidata fetch → normalize → enrich → embed → QA. Complete in <30 min, ≥120 entities/city.
Ingest 6 pilot cities: Mexico City, Barcelona, Tokyo, Lisbon, NYC, Bangkok. Pass QA checklist for all.
Multi-agent routing with state management and error handling
Deterministic agent sequencing with WorkflowState, strict JSON validation, graceful failures, retry logic.
Persist immutable trip context accessible to all agents. Append-only history with context snapshots.
Weather and events API integrations with caching
Integrate OpenWeatherMap API for 7-day forecasts. Cache 60min TTL. Mock fallback. Used in itinerary logic.
Integrate events API (PredictHQ or municipal data). City/date filtering. Event-based itinerary adjustments.
Feedback capture and entity re-ranking based on ratings
POST /api/v1/feedback endpoint. Day-level ratings, overall/pacing/authenticity/value ratings, comments, liked/disliked entities.
Weekly entity re-ranking based on feedback. Boost high-rated (>4.5), dampen low-rated (<3.0). Trust decay over time.
Per-agent cost tracking and Prometheus metrics
Track token usage and costs per agent call. Store in cost_tracking table. Alert if trip cost >$0.80.
Expose /metrics endpoint. Track: agent latency, cost/trip, feedback ratings, quota utilization. Grafana dashboards.
Schema-per-tenant isolation with usage quotas
Schema-per-tenant in PostgreSQL. Vector namespace per tenant in ChromaDB. Row-level security.
Enforce itineraries/month quotas per tier. Starter: 10, Pro: unlimited, Enterprise: unlimited + custom.
7-step onboarding: signup → preferences → city recommendation → itinerary → feedback. FastAPI endpoints.
RBAC
Three roles: admin, operator, viewer. JWT authentication. Permission enforcement on all endpoints.
Comprehensive audit logs: authentication, data access, trip creation, config changes. 1-year retention.
Fernet encryption at rest. TLS in transit. Encrypted backups. No PII in vectors.
Docker containerization and CI/CD pipeline
Dockerfile for API server. docker-compose.yml with API + Postgres + ChromaDB. Health checks.
GitHub Actions: automated testing, linting, code coverage >80%, staging deployment, production approval.
Pacing experiment infrastructure and variant assignment
Deterministic MD5-based assignment. 50/50 split between control and slow_hidden_gems. Stratify by city.
Variant performance comparison: overall rating, pacing complaints, completion rate. Statistical significance testing.
Real-time monitoring: sample sizes, metrics by variant, confidence levels, winner determination.
